prompt: Original premium editorial illustration for TravelLabs, a contemporary AI research lab for travel. Wide 3:2 composition. A bright modern research studio overlooking an airport runway and distant coastal hills through large floor-to-ceiling windows. Foreground: a clean pale desk with an open notebook containing loose pencil sketches of travel routes and a small model passenger aircraft, a slim closed laptop, one ceramic cup. At left a translucent glass whiteboard with very faint hand-drawn paths and small nodes, no legible text. Midground two simple empty chairs, indoor greenery. In the distance outside, a small airliner taxiing; calm turquoise and powder blue light. Contemporary architectural realism softened by impressionist painted texture, subtle human pencil marks, intelligent and welcoming, restrained sea green, cream and warm grey palette. Entirely new composition. No vintage furniture, no antique objects, no piled books, no sepia, no dark wooden desk, no logos, no people, no heavy outlines, no stock photo appearance. Fine craft and atmospheric depth. This should feel like a place where the future of travel is being made.
